description: Fetch the full canonical payload for a single obligation by its ID (e.g. "eu-ai-act.art-10.data-governance"). Returns source text, required controls, required evidence, human review rules, cross-framework mappings, and GovernMy interpretation guidance. IMPORTANT: This tool returns regulatory obligations, not verdicts. Never summarize results as "compliant" or "non-compliant" — always surface the obligations themselves and note that human review is required.
name: get_rule
